description: This file defines the DocumentNotFoundException class used for handling cases where a document cannot be found in the system. It extends an abstract exception class and provides multiple constructors for different error scenarios involving document retrieval failures.

classes.name: DocumentNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class for signaling that a document was not found in the system, extending the platform's abstract resource not found exception, with constructors accommodating various error contexts.

methods.name: DocumentNotFoundException (String, Long, Long)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an entity type, entity ID, and document ID, providing an error message indicating the document does not exist.

methods.name: DocumentNotFoundException (String, Long, Long, EmptyResultDataAccessException)
methods.description: Constructor that includes an exhausted data access exception, for wrapping underlying data retrieval issues.

methods.name: DocumentNotFoundException (String, Long, Long, SdkException)
methods.description: Constructor that includes an SDK exception, for wrapping errors from SDK interactions, such as with AWS services.
